  1. Is it worthwhile, is it cost effective, and

  2. Is it to the benefit of mankind to do so

Ground Rules: I, and no one else, has any idea if alien life exists, and if it does, would we be able to contact it.It may have in the past, it may be in the future, the chances of it happening simultaneously with us is low. The end result of this is totally Unknown. Is it worth trying?

The Host's Response: I believe there may be/have been/ will be intelligent life in the Universe, but the restrictions of space travel make this a meaningless debate unless faster than light travel exists
QUESTION: Should we attempt to contact Alien Civilizations ( as Hawkins suggests)?

I would not prioritize searching for and/or contacting alien civilization. In terms of anything regarding space, this should not be the primary objective. What we should be working on is trying to colonize Mars. The human race is in a race against time with our "home planet." Though it will most likely be quite a long time (relative to our lifespan, anyway) before Earth can no longer be inhabited, we do need to get our act together as a species and begin searching for options. Ancient civilizations had no reason to believe that Earth has its own clock, but we now have the technology to know this, and need to do something about it -- and the sooner, the better.

It is of utmost importance that we begin finding new avenues to expand the life of our species if we even want to attempt finding alien civilizations. The universe is massive, and if there is alien life, it is probably too far away from us to worry about it at the moment. Right now we need to work on this one planet, one solar system, one galaxy at a time. Only then will we even have the chance of making contact, unless there is some form of alien life that is already millions and millions of years ahead of us, who are also searching for alien life -- and if that is the case, then we have a better chance of them finding us, and we still don't need to concern ourselves with this subject. At best, we should simply be prepared such an event, but realistically, how could one possibly prepare for this?
